questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2019 season?
questions.explanation: Dané van Niekerk won it in 2019.

questions.question: At which ground did Madison Landsman record their career-best bowling figures (5-7, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2019/10/26.

questions.question: At Kimberley Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
Faye Tunnicliffe set a database record (21/22 season, T20) with a value of 215. Which record is it?
options: Best Bowling Figures in an Innings
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Runs', held by Faye Tunnicliffe.

questions.question: At which ground did Badgers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 332, against Kei on 2018/11/17.

questions.question: How many wicketkeeping dismissals separate the all-time #1 (Yolandi van der Westhuizen) and #2 (Trisha Chetty) wicketkeepers (List A)?
questions.explanation: Yolandi van der Westhuizen: 104 — Trisha Chetty: 94 — a gap of 10.
